snippet.title: [RF Online Next] Developer Commentary Episode 1: Game Introduction (Biosuit Overview)
snippet.description:
Hello, I'm Hong Kwangmin, Head of Development at RF Online Next.
I'm very pleased to be greeting you for the first time through this developer commentary.
RF Online Next was developed with endless growth and a richly varied combat experience as its core values.
Today, as our first topic, I'd like to introduce the Biosuit - a system that breaks the mold of fixed classes and has the power to change the tide of battle.

More than just a piece of equipment, the Biosuit lets you freely switch classes to suit any situation, enabling limitless growth. Watch the video to see what makes it so exciting.
Your new battle is about to begin. Thank you for watching to the end!
